event: Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US stock and bond markets shut, thin trade. Fri 27 Nov: US half-day. Mon 30 Nov: COMEX December first notice day (UNVERIFIED). Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: V-shaped bounce
bullets.text: Gold bounced from about 3,426 on Wednesday back toward 3,580 by 10:05 SAST today (ATFX, IC Markets).

bullets.title: Testing 3,600
bullets.text: An FXStreet headline at about 15:05 SAST says gold is rebounding toward 3,600, but the exact live price is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Hike largely priced
bullets.text: A Fed hike on 9 December is largely priced in after hot PCE data, which keeps the bigger trend down (ATFX, IC Markets).

bullets.title: Softer dollar, yields
bullets.text: The dollar index eased to about 103.7 and US yields dipped, which gave gold room to bounce (ATFX).

bullets.title: Tariffs and oil
bullets.text: New US tariff proposals on 14 economies and oil jumping after attacks on Saudi facilities add safe-haven support (ATFX).

bullets.title: Analysts still bearish
bullets.text: ATFX calls gold cautiously bearish and IC Markets strongly bearish for the next 24 hours.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: US stock and bond markets are shut for Thanksgiving, so breakouts are less reliable and can snap back.

look: This is against the bigger downtrend, so use half size or skip it.

A higher low on the 15M chart and a close back above 3,535.
Tariff or safe-haven headlines giving gold support.
Take some profit at 3,556 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying right under 3,591-3,600 now. Wait for the pullback.

sell.title: Sell plan: rally fails at 3,635-3,651 (with the main trend)
look: Price pushes up into 3,635-3,651 and stalls there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,625.
The dollar or yields firming again on Friday.
